structuredContent.body:
The exact-source P1R run 39663430445 exhausted its 15-minute job budget during real registration checks. Earlier suites all passed but consumed about 13 minutes, and later isolation/authority controls never ran.

Raise only the bounded job allowance to 30 minutes, retaining every step and all release acceptance guards. Validation: four publication/source workflow contract tests pass; exact commit/PR message passes the repository’s pinned commitlint CLI. Full PR CI/P1R and fresh push proofs after merge remain required before publication.
structuredContent.title: ci(p1r): allow bounded qualification suites to finish
